newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss shares end virtually unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Swiss shares end virtually unchanged.

text.p: 1430 GMT - Swiss shares ended a volatile day virtually unchanged in moderate volumes.
The expiry of options and futures on Soffex, the Swiss futures exchange, was smooth and did not affect shares prices much, one dealer said. Trade was rangebound.
* The blue-chip Swiss Market Index (SMI) was unchanged at 3,694.9 points.
* The all-share Swiss Performance Index (SPI) added 0.08 points to 2,368.42 points.
* Nestle, which led the actives list, was up four francs at 1,388 on foreign buy orders.
* Pharmaceuticals Ciba and Sandoz, which plan to merge as the new firm Novartis, gained 0.4 percent and 0.7 percent, respectively. Roche certificates gave up 80 francs to 9,185.

* Chemical firm Ems and quality control concern Surveillance were markedly lower after interim results were partly disappointing, one trader said. Surveillance sank three percent to 2,840 francs after reporting an 11 percent rise in first half-year net profit to 110.9 million francs, below some expections. Ems retreated 55 francs to 4,630. The company said group operating profit in the first eight months was 67 million francs versus 68 million francs year-on-year.
* Banks were mostly lower. Among the big three, UBS bearer shares ended up three francs to 1,173, while CS Holding and SBC fell 0.4 percent each.
* Insurers were mostly underpinned by recent good half-year results at Zurich. Winterthur added 13 francs to 766. Swiss Re slid four francs to 1,305.
* Industrials were mixed. Alusuisse, Elektrowatt, Holderbank and Sulzer finished lower.
